aligned(8) class ItemProperty(property_type) extends Box(property_type){}
aligned(8) class ItemFullProperty(property_type, version, flags) extends FullBox(property_type, version, flags){}

entries.description: Subsegment index box (14496-12:2015 8.16.4.2), which only its compressed form had
RTCP reception hint sample entry (14496-12:2015 9.4.2.3): otherwise identical in structure to the sample entry format for RTP
Multi-source presentation track group (14496-12:2015 8.3.4.3): the fields of a TrackGroupTypeBox alone

Sample auxiliary information sizes (14496-12 9th edition, as quoted in AOMediaCodec/av2-isobmff#60): versions 1 and 2 give each sample's size in 16 and 32 bits, for the auxiliary information of a sample of many subsamples. Read before the 8th edition's, version 0 alone, and so in place of it
